wholePhysicalScope: The named east wing, adjoining southern/northern/western galleries, and open inner court are fixed by two mapped outlines and an inner ring. The surrounding Royal University and Royal Palace have separate footprints.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the historic gallery footprint and open court, Khmer roof silhouette, gable spires and columned pavilions. Near views add tiled profiles, crest ornament, modeled columns, steps and courtyard bays.
limitations: Native map lines control the footprint and courtyard void. The roof heights, veranda depths, court plantings and historical roof fittings are interpreted from the archive silhouette and the written conservation description.
The model depicts the standing building with its original exterior composition and 1924 wings. Interior volumes, the underground store and adjoining university buildings are outside the model scope.
Terracotta and related tones are approximate. Medium-fi geometric relief represents carved gables and gilded or dark ridge details.

The independently sampled elevation is retained in the review. Higher present-day DEM returns beside the western galleries may include buildings and trees, and obscure the lowest wall courses locally.
